old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a hand interacting with various magnetic objects on a clean, white surface. Initially, the hand holds a small metallic sphere, which is then placed onto a wooden stick positioned horizontally across a gray platform. The platform is adorned with several small, circular magnets arranged in a row. As the hand moves away, the metallic sphere rolls down the wooden stick towards the magnets. In the background, a detailed model of the Petronas Twin Towers constructed from numerous small metallic spheres stands prominently on a rotating stand. The scene captures the dynamic interaction between the hand, the magnetic sphere, and the surrounding objects, emphasizing the properties of magnetism and the precision of the hand's movements. The video maintains a steady focus on these elements throughout its duration, highlighting the intricate details of the setup and the smooth motion of the sphere.

caption: The video showcases a white tabletop where two spired magnetic-ball tower sculptures stand on a circular base at the right, beside a gray plate holding two rows of disc magnets crossed by a wooden rail. A left hand in a gray sleeve steadies one dark ball on the right end of a short rail while the right hand lifts a second ball to it. The hands hold the pair close, the right hand inching its ball toward the first. The view then shows a long diagonal rail spanning the array, hands withdrawn except a fingertip at the left and one ball near the right end. A ball released at the left rolls rightward along the rail, blurring as it passes the discs. Reaching the right end it strikes the resting ball, knocking it onto the white base near the left tower while the incoming ball stays on the rail. The tower sculptures, magnet rows, and framing stay fixed throughout.
